en.description:
Welcome to Tile Isle, a multiplayer word game designed for groups large and small.

Key Features
• Multiplayer for up to 8 Players, play with a massive group of friends!
• Play Offline: Play against up to 7 CPU opponents across 4 difficulty levels, or pass your device around to take turns with multiple people. No internet connection needed.
• Customizable Match Rules: Tailor every game to fit your playstyle. Mix up the rules with a multitude of configuration options, including bigger board sizes, special tiles, and a ton of options for scoring and multipliers.
• Classic Word Mechanics: Enjoy familiar, satisfying crossword-style tile placement where strategic positioning and vocabulary are your keys to success.
• Quick, Effortless Matchmaking: Sign in automatically with Game Center, no account to create. Jump into Quick Play, get matched at random, or invite friends by simply sending a link.
• Stay in the Game: Track your matches from your wrist with the Apple Watch companion app and complications, or check in from your Home Screen or Lock Screen with widgets.
• Match History & Dictionary: Review every turn of a match: words played, definitions, and points earned. 
• Make It Yours: Personalize your board with purchasable themes.
en.releaseNotes:
New themes, a redesigned theme store, and lots of polish:

New paid themes: Bubbles, St. Patrick's, Rainy Day, Fireflies, Code Rain, and Balloons
Improvements to existing themes: Winter's snow now piles up on your board and buttons.
Autumn adds maple leaves to the mix. Lunar New Year's lanterns got a big overhaul. 
Volcano gets a superheated glow. New Year's gets nicer sky colors.
New free theme: Simple, a free minimalist theme for everyone.
Redesigned Customization page: Every theme now shows its colors, its tiles,
and all of its bonus square colors at a glance. Previews put you on a real board,
sidebar and all, and Classic is right there whenever you want the original
look back.
New on iPad, Mac, and iPhone Duo: a resizable sidebar. Press and hold
the handle between the board and sidebar, then drag. The sidebar can 
also be locked to a desired width in settings.
Rearranging tiles is smoother: they slide aside to show exactly where
a tile will land, and you can rearrange during your opponent's turn.
New: wait in a lobby for private matches. Gather everyone first, with
a match code to share and a live list of who's joined. The match starts once
every seat is filled, or turn it off to play the first turn right away while
friends join later.
New: Live Activity for online matches (turn it on in Settings). Your
score, the tiles left, and the latest move on the Lock Screen and in the
Dynamic Island, which pops open when it's your turn.
Apple Watch: smoother panning around the board, especially on big
boards, and a roomier Swap screen with bigger tiles. The board on 
your watch now matches the theme you've picked on your iPhone.
Fixed: the snow (and other falling effects) could occasionally stutter.
Fixed: tapping an online game's notification during a game against the
computer could leave things in a confused state.
Improved: Some additional iPhone Duo-specific polish.
en.subtitle: 2-8 Player Crossword Game!

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
iMessage "Shared with You" Integration
• When friends send you a game invite link via iMessage, it will now automatically surface right inside your Tile Isle app!

Visual Improvements
• Tiles: Tiles places on the board now form one continuous shape, along with easier to see indicators for when a tile is placed on a multiplier space.
• Improved the look & feel of the title screen, scoreboard, and other menus.
Quality of Life Improvements
• Persistent Sharing: Easily resend invite links to friends at any time from active matches, until they're full.
• Better Board Sync: If an opponent takes their turn while you are testing out a word on your screen, the board will instantly update underneath you without deleting the tiles you were placing!
Under-the-Hood Fixes
• Drastically reduced app load times by loading the game dictionary in the background.
• Completely rebuilt our Game Center synchronization engine to eliminate game desyncs, missing turns, and match deletion errors.
• Improved handling for inactive players and match timeouts.

Thank you for playing Tile Isle! If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review.

New: 9 Purchasable Themes!
Restyle the whole board with a brand new Customization screen. Each theme repaints your board, tiles, and buttons, and brings its own animated background: rolling waves, falling snow, paper lanterns or bursting fireworks. Preview any theme on a live board before you buy.

Also new: more haptics, and a smoother more responsive board when dragging and placing tiles.

Plus assorted bug fixes and polish.

Rebuilt online multiplayer from the ground up. This means faster matchmaking, more reliable turn notifications, and the ability to do some fun new things like an APPLE WATCH APP. Play your turns from your wrist, even when your phone isn't nearby!

Other new things:
• Online multiplayer rebuilt on new infrastructure. Matches connect faster, turns sync in real time, and matchmaking is much improved.
• Added Home Screen widgets that will show when it's your turn, and your most recent matches.
• Faster, more reliable, and more descriptive "your turn" and "game over" notifications.

NOTE: One-time change! This update includes an overhaul of the multiplayer backend that does not carry forward matches already in progress. Any online matches you're currently playing will be lost upon updating to 1.3. Apologies for any inconvenience, this won't need to happen again going forward! :)
Pass & Play games and your on-device settings and themes are not affected.

Thanks for playing Tile Isle. Please leave a review if you're enjoying the game!

Play against the computer, join matches from your wrist, and more:

New: play against a computer opponent. Pick from four difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, or Insane, and play solo against up to 8 CPU opponents. No internet connection needed.
New: Apple Watch complication. Add Tile Isle to your watch face to see whose turn it is, the score, and tiles left at a glance. 
New: Quick Play and Join Random Match are now available right on the watch, alongside seeing matches where it's not your turn.
New: Lock Screen widget for iPhone. Check your matches without unlocking your phone.
Fixed: joining a match no longer sends the other players a notification claiming you played a turn. It now correctly says you joined.
Various polish: smoother pass/swap flow, better zoom control with a mouse or trackpad, and other small fixes.

Match history, a score graph, word definitions, and a bundle to unlock every theme at once:

New: Match History. See every turn of the match — the words played, their definitions, and the points earned — grouped by round, with a sortable list and a graph of each player's score over time.
New: word definitions in Search Dictionary. Look up a word while you play and see its definition and part of speech, not just whether it's valid.
New: see who's online. A green dot shows when an opponent currently has the match open.
New: Unlock All Themes bundle. One purchase unlocks every board theme — including any added in future updates.
New rule option: Blanks Can Become Exclamation Tiles.
Fixed: an unfilled seat in an online match no longer disrupts turn order.
Numerous reliability and polish improvements across iPhone and Apple Watch.

Thanks for playing Tile Isle, if you're enjoying the app, please leave a review! 
- Evan :)

- Fixed: a theme unlocked only through the "Unlock All Themes" bundle (rather than purchased individually) could show its toggle in Customization but not actually turn on.
- Fixed: the back button was tappable while a confirmation dialog (like forfeiting a match) was on screen.
- Under-the-hood improvements to match connection reliability.

If you're enjoying Tile Isle, consider leaving a rating or review!
- Evan :)

Way better iPad and Mac support!

- New: landscape and resizable windows on iPad and Mac. Play in
  landscape, or resize the window freely. The board screen gains a
  collapsible sidebar alongside the board for Match History, Scoreboard,
  and the Score Graph.
- Fixed: dragging a tile onto the board could make it flicker or briefly
  disappear right after placing it.
- Fixed: the board could zoom out further than the window in some
  layouts, leaving part of it cut off.
- Fixed: the pass-and-play privacy screen didn't always fully cover the
  tile rack.
- Fixed: Online Matches could stay stuck disabled if the app launched
  without an internet connection, even after reconnecting. It now shows
  a "Connect to Online Matches" button to retry.
- Online Matches is now green once you're signed in, matching the online
  indicators used elsewhere in the app.
- New: Game Size replaces the separate Board Size and Tile Count
  settings. Four options: Normal, Large, Huge, and Insane; each
  pairing a board size with a tile count tuned to match it, including a
  brand-new 19×19 board.
- Fixed: swapping tiles in an online match could occasionally swap
  different tiles than the ones you'd selected.
- Fixed: when a match continues after a player leaves, the next player now
  gets a proper "Your Turn!" notification instead of just being told
  someone left.
- Added a few more valid words to the dictionary.

Updated for iPhone Duo, plus a round of fixes:

- New: iPhone Duo support. Open it up or hold it like a book for the board and sidebar side by side, split right at the hinge. Prop it up like a laptop and the board takes the top screen while your tiles sit on the bottom. Plus, a ton of other considerations to make the Duo experience as smooth as possible :)

- Fixed: the app's notification badge number could sometimes be incorrect.
- Fixed: zooming all the way out could leave part of the board cut off after resizing or rotating.
- Fixed: Match History entries could sometimes be incorrect at the end of matches.

- Improved: Word definitions load faster when you revisit Match History.
- Improved: Added a few more valid words to the dictionary.
